title: Get Started with cfb4th
text: shows bare minimum amount information fed cfb4th order compute 4th decision recommendations. main function user-input data add_4th_probs(). Teams included help model easily track simulations.
code: one_play <-   tibble::tibble(       # Game Info       home = "Utah",       away = "BYU",       pos_team = "Utah",       def_pos_team = "BYU",       spread = -7,       over_under = 55,        # Situation Info       half = 2,       period = 3, # Quarter       TimeSecsRem = 900, # Half Seconds Remaining       adj_TimeSecsRem = 900, # Game Seconds Remaining       down = 4,       distance = 4,       yards_to_goal = 40,       pos_score_diff_start = 7,        pos_team_receives_2H_kickoff = 1,       pos_team_timeouts_rem_before = 3,       def_pos_team_timeouts_rem_before = 3      ) one_play %>%   cfb4th::add_4th_probs() %>%   dplyr::select(     pos_team, distance, yards_to_goal, go_boost, first_down_prob,      wp_fail, wp_succeed, go_wp, fg_make_prob, miss_fg_wp, make_fg_wp,      fg_wp, punt_wp   ) %>%   knitr::kable(digits = 2) #> Computing probabilities for 1 plays. . .

title: cfb4th 0.2.0
text: First CRAN release. load_4th_pbp() ranks betting-line providers CFBD now serves (Bovada, DraftKings, ESPN Bet), game without Bovada line gets fixed choice instead whichever unranked book came first. Model loading now mirrors nfl4th. expected-points field-goal models ship package (field-goal model refreshed copy cfbfastR-data), nothing downloaded package attached. two xgboost models (fourth-conversion win probability), 17 MB together, longer bundled: downloaded package’s model_archive GitHub release first time needed cached tools::R_user_dir("cfb4th", "cache"); new cfb4th_clear_cache() forces fresh download. installed package shrinks 17 MB 2 MB, failed download one informative error instead failure inside model call. get_4th_plays() requests ESPN game summary HTTPS. get_4th_plays() errors clearly unless df one row game_id, home_team away_team. , empty input (cfbfastR::cfbd_game_info() returns CFBD API rejects key) gave data frame columns, caller failed later “Column desc doesn’t exist”. model cache kept folder named package version, caching model removes caches versions, upgrade never leaves stale models behind. Caching model now prints saved, model download allows least 300 seconds. get_4th_plays() example now runs (\donttest). load_4th_pbp() example runs interactive session CFBD API key set: scoring one season’s ~10,000 fourth downs takes minute. load_4th_pbp() works ‘cfbfastR’ 3.x, whose play--play already spread over_under columns: replaced provider-ranked betting lines instead split .x/.y columns, made add_4th_probs() fail. provider spread preferred, play--play’s line fills chosen provider none, provider / formatted_spread describe line used. load_4th_pbp() longer fails “Column provider found” CFBD API returns betting lines. cfbfastR::cfbd_betting_lines() returns empty data frame API error, rate limit (HTTP 429) included; load_4th_pbp() now warns keeps play--play’s spread /. Lines without provider column ranked spread alone, warning provider set NA. get_4th_plays() likewise tolerates games ESPN betting lines. load_4th_pbp() gives clear error season’s play--play empty, add_4th_probs() returns NA probabilities (warning, non-empty input) instead failing play can scored. cfb4th_clear_cache() example uses temporary cache folder, longer deletes user’s cached models. dplyr (>= 1.0.0) required, any_of(). cli new import. Removed unused suggested packages (future, gt, rmarkdown, tictoc, tidyselect, tidyverse).
